title: Redeploy site and make live URL discoverable + fix potential asset path issues

requirements.text: Redeploy the website and provide the final working live URL as part of the deployment output/instructions.

quotes: The previous link is not opening. Please redeploy my site now and give me the final live URL.

acceptanceCriteria: A single final live URL is produced and shared back (copy/paste ready).
Opening the final live URL in a new browser session loads the site successfully (no blank page / no generic error).

requirements.text: Add a small "Live URL" display in the site footer that shows the current site origin (e.g., https://... ) with a copy-to-clipboard button so the user can retrieve the correct live URL directly from the deployed site.

quotes: Please redeploy my site now and give me the final live URL.

acceptanceCriteria: The footer renders a label "Live URL" and displays the value derived from the browser location origin.
A "Copy" control copies the URL to clipboard and provides a simple success confirmation message (English).
The feature does not require login and works on desktop and mobile widths.

requirements.text: Make static asset URLs (shop-board logo and banner) robust to different deployment base paths by avoiding hard-coded absolute paths that can break when the app is not served from domain root.

quotes: The previous link is not opening.

acceptanceCriteria: Header logo and hero banner images load correctly on the deployed site (no 404s).
Footer logo image loads correctly on the deployed site (no 404s).
No other site content/regressions are introduced (navigation/sections still render and smooth scroll works).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add migration.mo only if persistent state upgrades are required (not expected for this change).
nonGoals: Adding custom domains or external DNS configuration.
Adding a backend API just to report the deployment URL.
Implementing real-time monitoring or uptime checks.
